description: This file defines an abstract class 'ListableDisplayField' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\DisplayField'. It extends another class 'CombinedDisplayField'. The file appears to serve as a base class for display fields that can be listed in report displays within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ListableDisplayField
classes.description: An abstract class intended to be extended by display fields that can be listed in reports, providing a base for more specific implementations.
